opis: Test wtrysku: cale pierwsze scenki (narracja + dialogi). Repozytorium nie zawiera danych gry - ten plik trzyma tylko offsety, skroty MD5 i nasze angielskie linie. Japonski tekst jest czytany z Twojego ISO i pokazywany na ekranie.

lines.text:
Decades have passed since the Earth Federation,
a unified government of all mankind, was founded.
Human science, technology and economy gathered pace,
giant space colonies rose around the Earth,
and the Universal Century began.

In time humanity spread across the solar system
and grew mighty on vast resources and energy.
But as human activity raced ahead, prosperity
magnified the scale of every problem as well.

An expanding economy bred inequality and drew
vast money, resources and people into criminal
hands. Terrorist and pirate groups grew bolder,
and men like Dr. Hell appeared, openly declaring
world conquest and defying all of humanity.

But the Earth Federation Forces could not keep up.
Old national governments and the colonies were
forced to arm themselves for their own defence.
That arms race, of course, only raised tension
between nations and between peoples, and it took
little time for the ideal of a unified government
to be lost.

Ironically, war accelerated science even further,
giving birth to one runaway technology after
another -- the Devil Gundam incident being the
most notorious.

In the same way, research into unknown energies
altered the energy balance of the Earth itself,
and became the very thing that invites invasion
by races that are not human.

The Invaders, the Muge Empire, the evil god
Dragon, the Machine Empire, the Jark Empire,
the Great Demon World -- threats beyond human
comprehension struck the Earth Sphere one after
another, and the memory is still fresh.

But humanity has overcome crisis after crisis,
rebuilding and pressing on, again and again.

Even with the fear of a threat that may come at
any moment, people live each day with strength.

(I am now at Connect, a civilian
organization promoting space trade...)

(Connect is famous, but its origins
and true purpose are unknown...)

(People of Earth have faced so many
disasters that one company's doings
are not worth their attention.)

(But that is fine. If I reach my goal
without anyone knowing,
so much the better...)
Now then, it is time for training.
Ah, ah, testing, testing.
＜主人公名＞, can you hear me?

Read you loud and clear!
Let us begin the mission.

Catapult connected!
Exert, please launch!
Understood!
CF-00 Exert, launching!

Today you will test combat manoeuvres
using the new mobility control system.
First, please 'Move' to the designated area.
Roger! Moving to the target!
Displaying the designated area.

Target confirmed!
Beginning 'Move' now.
EN resupply complete!
Next, we will recover 'Parts'.
Deploying container blocks.

"At the same coordinates as a 'Container',
 the unit identifies and recovers 'Parts'
 on its own."

Roger!
After moving to the 'Container' coordinates,
I will recover the 'Parts'.
Parts recovery complete!

This is a repair kit that patches up damage
in the field. Good to have one aboard.
Now we move on to combat manoeuvres.
Displaying a simulated enemy.
Enemy unit confirmed!

Well now... this one does not look
like a simulation.
The system was upgraded the other day.

Impact from hits is fed back into the unit,
so combat feels far more real, they say.
That I have to see.
Beginning 'Attack'!

Halt!
The Exert hangar is off limits to outsiders.
How did you get in?

Oh, I am sorry!
I have been transferred here from the 44th
General Affairs Department.

This is only my first year with the company,
but I look forward to working with you!

So you are...?
The new member of the Connect Force, then.

Yes! My name is Himari Yaegaki.
I am from Japan on Earth. I studied
engineering.
I see. Nice to meet y--

People say I do not look the science type,
but I skipped grades and finished my master's.
I see. That is impress--

My favourites are yakiniku, ramen and
dessert buffets. And with dessert...
a caramel macchiato, no question!

Oh, there was pilot and operator training
last week, and, well... I cannot even drive,
so will I really be all right...?
Er... hold on a moment...

I can push myself through most things,
but the cold is one thing I am bad with...
Oh, but I do love a good bath! And also...
T-that is quite enough!
Ah... I am sorry!
I talked far too much, did I not...

We are the Connect Force, a combat unit.
Long chats on duty get people killed.
Save them for later.
Understood... I will be careful.
Good.
Um, may I ask you one question?

You said combat unit just now,
but what do we actually do?

Nobody told me anything when I
was transferred...
Just what it says. We are expected to fight.

The robot in front of you is no work machine.
It is the newest weapon, made for any mission.
A weapon...?

What?! Why would a private
company like Connect...?

Everyone assigned here is
surprised at first...

But once you know the purpose, you will see
this is the most rewarding work here.
Is that so.

Still, hearing you say it so firmly, senior,
makes me want to work harder!

You have what it takes. You were chosen
from hundreds of thousands of candidates.
So I am one of the chosen?!
Well... I would not go that far.

For now this is combat training, but you
never know when something might happen.

Make every day count, and always
do your best!
Yes! I will do my best!

(I did not expect a fresh graduate.
 I thought we would get an old hand...)

(Surely this project is not
 short of people...)
Welcome back, senior!
Good work, Himari.

Send the data on to Headquarters for analysis.
Do you know how?
The data... er... how do I...?
You have not been taught this?
Sorry, I have not studied enough...

It seems I have a lot to teach you yet.
Let me walk you through the steps.

Sorry.
I am keeping you late because of this.
Do not worry about that.

This job really can cost you your life.
Keep that in mind, all right?
Yes!

(Himari's assignment was the organisation's
 choice. She must be key to the project.)

(Well, what she does not know can be taught.
 What matters is how she fits the team.)
